events.evidence: Basque separatist group ETA announce a permanent ceasefire to their 38-year campaign for independence from Spain
A bankruptcy court judge in New York has authorized the creation of an equity holders' committee in connection with the reorganization of auto parts maker Delphi Corporation
The MV Queen of the North, a 125 metre ferry operated by BC Ferries, strikes a rock in British Columbia's Inside Passage shortly after midnight, and sinks

label.note: ETA ceasefire is a significant de-escalation; Delphi bankruptcy and ferry sinking are localized adverse items.
